package.description: Command-line client for PigCloud end-to-end encrypted cloud storage.

en-US.description: Command-line client for PigCloud end-to-end encrypted cloud storage.
en-US.longDescription:
PigCloud CLI is the command-line client for PigCloud, an end-to-end encrypted cloud storage
service. It uploads, downloads, and synchronises files without the server ever seeing plaintext:
encryption and decryption happen on your machine, and file names are obfuscated before they
reach storage.

The package installs two interchangeable commands, pigcloud and pc, which are the same binary.
Both support browsing and transferring files, mounting a PigCloud account as a local drive,
device-based login without storing a password, and managing encryption keys through a local
key agent.
en-US.name: PigCloud CLI
